description: Implement the complete Git Repositories page replacing the placeholder in GitRepos.tsx with full design including header, stat cards, tab navigation, filter bar, repositories table, pagination, bottom charts section, and right sidebar
steps: Replace dashboard/src/pages/GitRepos.tsx completely with the full implementation
Import Card from '@/components/common/Card' following the pattern in Tasks.tsx

Import all needed lucide-react icons: GitBranch, Folder, Activity, GitCommit, GitPullRequest, Eye, CheckCircle2, Plus, Search, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Star, MoreVertical, List, Grid, ArrowUp, Lock, Globe
Import recharts components: BarChart, Bar, PieChart, Pie, Cell, LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer

Define static mock data at top: stat cards array, repositories array (8 items with all fields), commit activity bar chart data (May 10-16), PR donut data, merge trends line chart data, code health metrics, activity feed items (7), top contributors (5), language distribution donut data
Implement page header with Git icon, title 'Git Repositories', subtitle, and right-side buttons (Connect Repository outlined, + New Repository green)
Implement 6 stat cards in a grid row following the Card padding='lg' pattern from Tasks.tsx
Implement tab navigation (All Repositories active, My Repositories, Starred, Archived)
Implement filter bar with search input, 4 dropdown selects (All Status, All Languages, All Visibility, Sort: Recent Activity), and view toggle buttons (list/grid)
Implement repositories table inside Card padding='none' with columns: Repository, Language, Last Commit, Status, Updated, Actions. 8 rows of data as specified.
Implement pagination below table: 'Showing 1 to 8 of 18 repositories', page buttons (< 1 2 3 >), '10 / page' dropdown
Implement bottom four-column section: Commit Activity bar chart, Pull Requests donut, Merge Trends line chart, Code Health score card with circular progress
Implement right sidebar (~w-80) with: Repository Activity feed (7 items), Top Contributors (5 items with commits and change %), Language Distribution donut chart
Use flex gap layout for main content + sidebar (same pattern as Tasks.tsx)
Ensure all TypeScript types are correct - no 'any' types, proper typing for data arrays
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors and zero warnings
GitRepos.tsx exports a GitRepos function component
Page renders 6 stat cards, repositories table with 8 rows, 4 bottom charts, and right sidebar
All text uses white/gray-400/gray-500 color scheme on dark background
All charts use recharts (BarChart, PieChart donut, LineChart)
Static mock data only - no API calls, no randomness, no Math.random()
findings: Node.js was not available in the environment. Installed via mise (MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false) after also installing libatomic1 via dnf. Build passes with zero TS errors. The chunk size warning about App-CEXEsFCu.js being > 500 kB is pre-existing and not caused by this change.
